data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in the net provision for claims includes a release of GBP 22.8m in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end (2013: GBP 20.4m).

named_events.loss_description: Sandy affected accounts required corrective action

data.standardized_narrative: At the start of 2014 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 360.523m. During the year there was a net release of prior year claims provisions of GBP 22.8m, driven principally by favourable run-off in long-tail casualty classes. This resulted in a prior-year release of approximately 6.3% of opening gross claims outstanding.
raw_causal_phrases: release of GBP 22.8m in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end (2013: GBP 20.4m).
favourable run-off of the long-tail casualty classes.
A positive run-off of GBP 10.0m on the 2012 and prior years' reserves (2011 and prior: GBP 17.2m) was experienced in the year.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year movement figure was located. The report explicitly states a net release of GBP 22.8m in the net provision for claims; this net figure has been used as a fallback for prior_year_development_gbp_m and is flagged as such. A gross movement (insurance liabilities column) was not found in the notes or a gross claims development triangle was not available; therefore gross prior year movement is unknown. The report also contains RITC activity (reinsurance to close) which can distort development measures for some year columns.
